raw_text: APT28 reportedly targeting Indian embassies across Europe with spear-phishing campaign. The weaponized PDFs are disguised as MEA circulars about diplomatic postings. This is significant because APT28 is GRU Unit 26165, the same group behind the DNC hack and numerous European operations. India being targeted suggests expanding Russian cyber espionage scope. Anyone have the IOCs to check their networks?
